# Export parity with Playwright (Chromium)

<!-- Generated by `dotnet run --project tools/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.ChromiumDiff -- --render --summary tools/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.ChromiumDiff/render-parity.md`: do not edit -->

The fixtures of `render-corpus` exported by Playwright (Chromium 156.0.8078.4) and by the library, compared pixel by pixel (the PDF are rasterized by pdftoppm). A result is *unsupported* when the library has no equivalent of a Playwright option of the scenario (the library renders without it), *known* when the difference is accepted in `render-known-differences.json`.

| Status | Count |
|---|---|
| Pass | 74 |
| Known | 62 |
| Unsupported | 0 |
| Unexpected | 0 |
| Error | 0 |
